title: clerodendrum kaempferi var. album
intro: Clerodendrum kaempferi var. album, commonly known as the White Glory Bower, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is a flowering plant known for its fragrant white flowers and has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Clerodendrum kaempferi var. album include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
